# Essentia Wellness Club

> Essentia is a longevity centre and social wellness club in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Today it offers manual therapies, therapeutic facials and IV therapy, booked online and given at the centre.

- Website: https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com
- Address: Rambla de Santa Cruz, 83, 38004 Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rambla+de+Santa+Cruz+83%2C+38004+Santa+Cruz+de+Tenerife
- Email: info@essentiawellnessclub.com
- Phone: +34 634 09 12 95
- Booking: https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/booking
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/essentiamassage
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/essentia
- Languages: English and Spanish (the Spanish pages are under /es/)

Prices are not listed in this file. The centre changes them, and the current price of each treatment is on its own page, under its name, next to how long it lasts.

## Services

Bookable online, given at the centre.

- [Manual Therapies](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies): Precise manual work to release tension and restore mobility. 11 treatments, each with its own page.
- [Therapeutic Facials](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/facial-therapies): Advanced facial protocols combining manual techniques and technology to restore skin health. 4 treatments, each with its own page.
- [IV Therapy](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy): Personalised intravenous protocols with vitamins, minerals and micronutrients, always under medical assessment. 12 treatments, each with its own page.
